about: Pre-registered random partitions of the 35 drawn roles into six disjoint groups with the kd groups' sizes; R5-R9 are built from them exactly as D5-D9 are built from the kd groups. Split 0 is the primary (materialised like D5-D9); splits 1-99 are the null distribution. Fixed 2026-10-10, before any rollout existed.
seed_rule: split i: random.Random(1000000 + i).sample(sorted(roles), 35), dealt A..F in order
